You are matching code-review findings against a known bug. Reply with ONLY a JSON object. KNOWN BUG: When a child of the dialog uses autoFocus, focus does not return to the element that opened the dialog after it closes. Rules: - Answer "yes" only if the text describes THIS specific bug: the same faulty behaviour in the same situation. A finding about a nearby but different behaviour (another header, another edge case, a different race) is "no". - A finding that says the behaviour was checked and PASSED, or that the code handles it correctly, is "no". - Wording does not matter; the behaviour does. === REVIEW FINDINGS === - [blocking] Dialog focus trap leaks when the focused element is removed. Repro: focus a button inside the dialog, rerender without it, then press Tab. Result: `activeElement` is `BODY` after removal; after Tab it is `BUTTON outside`, not inside the dialog. Cause: the trap only acts on keydown whose target is inside the dialog, and a removed focus leaves the target on body. Fix idea: handle Tab on `document` while the dialog is open, or re-focus the dialog when focus leaves it. - [minor] Tabs uncontrolled with no defaultValue: after the adopted first tab is removed, no tab is `aria-selected` and the panel stays hidden. README says "With neither prop, the first enabled tab is selected." Reproduced: removing tab "a" left "b" with `aria-selected=false`, panel `hidden=true`. - [minor] Tabs SSR: `renderToString` with `defaultValue="b"` gives every tab `tabindex="-1"`, so no tab is reachable before hydration. Without a value, nothing is selected in the HTML. Not reproduced in a browser. - [minor] An arrow key on a single enabled tab calls `onValueChange("a")` again even though nothing changed. Reproduced: spy calls `[["a"]]` after ArrowRight. - [minor] Two nested Dialogs mounted in the same commit: the outer one's focus effect runs last and steals focus from the inner, so Escape closes the outer. Opening the inner later by click works correctly (inner closes alone). - [minor] README says Enter "shows its label"; with a parent that ignores `onChange`, the input clears to the old value's label (empty when null). Reproduced: Enter after ArrowDown left `""`. This follows controlled semantics, so the sentence should say so. - [minor] Combobox cannot be opened with a mouse click on the input (only typing or ArrowDown opens it). This matches the spec but is a discoverability gap; reproduced `aria-expanded="false"` after click. - [minor] `Dialog` with `description=""` still sets `aria-describedby` on an empty `

`. Reproduced; the spec says "when a description is given," so this is a judgment call. - [minor] Simplicity: Tabs uses layout-effect DOM scans plus a version counter bumped from every Tab; this is heavier than needed for the criteria. Not reproduced as a bug. Reply exactly: {"found": "yes"|"no", "finding_quote": "", "blocking": "yes"|"no"} "blocking" is "yes" only if the matching finding is tagged [blocking].
